findings.title: Warning list uses message as React key
findings.problem: <li key={message}> collides when two warnings render the same text (e.g. identical consumer_slot 'tool (Type)' lines or empty messages).
findings.impact: Duplicate keys make React drop or misrender list items; reachability of duplicates not confirmed against backend output.

findings.title: Row key is the editable tool name
findings.problem: key={item.name} is empty for a new row and changes when the tool is chosen; loaded config with duplicate names yields duplicate keys.
findings.impact: Rows remount on selection (lost state/focus), duplicates misrender and share one error; reachability of duplicates unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Key rows by index or a stable generated id.

findings.title: Issues summary omits script_tool_access
findings.problem: toolField summary only chains tool, integration_alias and mcp_server.description; script_tool_access is absent, so spec point 4 and the story AC for the issues list are unmet.
findings.impact: An 'Invalid script tool access' error is not shown in the tool-step issues summary and is never displayed at all when the step is not currently a script tool.
findings.recommendation: Add getIssueField('script_tool_access') to the toolField fallback chain and render its error outside the isScriptTool block.

findings.title: Owner-integration toast lacks longer duration
findings.problem: notifyScriptOwnerIntegration calls toaster.info with default 3000 ms; the spec/story AC requires a longer duration for this kind, and toaster.info accepts no duration option.
findings.impact: The advisory about running under the author's integration disappears before it can be read; required behavior missing.
findings.recommendation: Extend toaster.info with an optional duration and pass a longer one here.
